contexts.text: That the falsities once put away will be put away to eternity, Signified.
When the Lord... has put away the evils and falsities which infest the Church. Signified, Explained.
That evils (and falsities of worship) are to be completely put away. Signified, Explained. AC 9321.
That the first of charity is to put away evils... General article. TCR 437.
